basic.name: Fel Flame (Q)
basic.description: Release a wave of flame, dealing 210 damage to enemies. {highlight}Cast range increased by 25%.{/highlight}
basic.developerCommentary: Gul'dan Fel Flame currently has a problem..depending on how you build Gul'dan Fel Flame becomes your priority skill by far or the useless one and with the other changes i propose on the Fel Flame aspect one thing is prevalent..Without the extra cast range there's almost no incentive to use it.

basic.name: Drain Life (W)
basic.description: Drain the life from an enemy over 3 seconds, dealing 132 damage per second and healing Gul'dan for 188 Health per second.

basic.name: Corruption (E)
basic.description: Call forth three bursts of shadow energy, dealing 204 damage over 6 seconds. Corruption can stack up to 3 times on an enemy.

heroic.name: Horrify (R)
heroic.description: After 0.75 seconds, deal 120 damage to enemy Heroes in an area and Fear them for 2 seconds. While Feared, Heroes are Silenced and are forced to run away from Horrify's center.

heroic.name: Rain of Destruction (R)
heroic.description: After 1.5 seconds, summon a rain of meteors in an {highlight}small area{/highlight} for 7 seconds{highlight}, that area will expand within it's duration{/highlight}. Each meteor deals 165 damage in a small area.{highlight} Reduced 50% damage on structures {/highlight}
heroic.developerCommentary: My initial idea was to make Rain of Destruction have a smaller radius since the beginning and make it have charges but that would make it too similar on Jaina Blizzard and after thinking a little RoD greatest problem was the uncertainty of it's effect as it one of the few skills that are affected by luck on Heroes of the storm. End result was not go away from the similarity to Blizzard but make it on a unique way.
subtexts: This won't change the meteor spawn rate it will just concentrate the damage at the beginning at a smaller area.

trait.name: Life Tap (T)
trait.description: Gul'dan does not regenerate Mana.Activate to restore 25% of Gul'dan's Mana.

general.name: Base
general.description: Fel Flame cast range increased by 25%.
general.developerCommentary: Gul'dan Fel Flame currently has a problem..depending on how you build Gul'dan Fel Flame becomes your priority skill by far or the useless one and with the other changes i propose on the Fel Flame aspect one thing is prevalent..Without the extra cast range there's almost no incentive to use it.

1.name: Chaotic Energy
1.description: {highlight}Drain life reduces the target self-heal and regeneration effects by 75% while it's active.{/highlight}
1.developerCommentary: I am not a big fan of reducing Gul'dan skills cost but rather give him more talents on the complete build that could sustain it's skill so instead in changing it for a situational talent.
subtexts: For complete context, it won't reduce healing from other heroes. For example Dehaka Essence Collection or Dehaka Adaptation healing will be cut but receiving healing from a Healer will work normally.

1.name: Rampant Hellfire
1.description: {highlight}Hitting Corruption affected targets with fel flame restores Gul'dan life by 22.5 this bonus is increased to 90 on heroes{/highlight}
1.quest: Hit 30 enemy Heroes with Fel Flame.
rewards: Fel Flame's radius is increased by 10%.
1.developerCommentary: Corruption is a high cost skill that Gul'dan players should take a little more care to use BUT i wanted to increase interactions between Corruption and the rest of the Kit. Also i wanted to provide some 'more' to the pursuit of flame as it's not very popular for being a little dull

1.name: Consume Life
1.description: {quest}Quest:{/quest} Killing troops increase Gul'dan maximun health points by 0.3% up to 20%. {reward}Reward:{/reward} If Consume life is fully charged it can be activated while dead to immediately respawn at the Hall of Storms, but must be charged again.
1.developerCommentary: I wanted to make something related to the Vanilla Dark Bargain effect but i disliked increasing respawn time the way it is..on counterpart the Malthael level 20 talent No One Can Stop Death gives a better control of it

4.name: Harvest Life
4.description: Drain Life heals for 75% more Health when used on Heroes.
4.developerCommentary: I want to make players choose one Drain Life bonus instead of building Drain Life, one of the things that make Harvest Life is strong is the combination with Curse of Exhaustion

4.name: Curse of Exhaustion
4.description: Drain Life deals 50% more damage and Slows the target's Movement Speed by 40%.
4.developerCommentary: I want to make players choose one Drain Life bonus instead of building Drain Life

4.name: Drain Power
4.description: {highlight}Drain life will steal 7.5% spell power per second if used on corruption affected enemies, Gul'dan will retain the spell power for 4 seconds after stop draining{/highlight}
4.developerCommentary: Gul'dan is well known for drain vital essence and i think that can be transferred to spell power

7.name: Bound by Shadow
7.description: Each enemy Hero hit with Fel Flame reduces the cooldown of Corruption by 1.75 seconds.

7.name: Darkness Within
7.description: Dealing 600 (+4% per level) damage to enemy Heroes causes the next cast of Life Tap to cost no Health{highlight} and increases the mana restored to 60%.{/highlight}
7.developerCommentary: I want Hungry for power and Drain power to be the only ways to obtain more spellpower so instead i am bringing this talent for a sustain.

7.name: Hunger for Power
7.description: Increases Spell Power by 15% but reduces healing received from allies by 25%.

13.name: Fel Armor
13.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Fel Flame grants 50 Spell Armor for 2.5 seconds, reducing Ability Damage taken by 50%.

13.name: Dark Bargain
13.description: {highlight}Activate to consume a enemy or allied hero body to absorb their maximum health points, the extra health granted will decay over 15 seconds.{/highlight}
13.developerCommentary: Gul'dan is known for trying increase his own lifespan be it by changing bodies or draining life essence, it's totally on lore for him doing it.
subtexts: This will consume their maximum health points after death. So if you guldan has 3000hp and kill a maximum souls Diablo that had 8k life by losing his souls lets say he has 6k life now then you will be granted 6k health points.
This will literally consume the corpse so Auriel Resurrect can't be used on the consumed target

13.name: Healthstone
13.description: Activate to heal for 25% of Gul'dan's maximum Health.

16.name: Drain Hope
16.description: {highlight}Activate to channel for 1.5 second, and then instantly teleport and cast drain life on all enemies in range.{/highlight}
passives: {highlight}Enemies that take full Drain life take additional 8% maximum health damage on the end{/highlight}
16.developerCommentary: Inspired by Fiddlesticks ultimate i wanted to create some way to make a ultra power move with Drain Life and make the Chupacabra build a little different.

16.name: Rampant Hellfire
16.description: Fel Flame's damage is increased by 12% for 5 seconds when hitting an enemy Hero. This can stack up to 5 times.

16.name: Echoed Corruption
16.description: After the third strike, Corruption strikes 3 times in the opposite direction.
16.developerCommentary: This is a strong level 16 contender and with the new level 20 talent it becomes more willing to be picked.

20.name: Haunt
20.description: Increases the duration of Horrify by 1 second, and while Feared, enemies lose 20 Armor, causing them to take 20% increased damage.

20.name: Deep Impact
20.description: Rain of Destruction slows enemies Movement Speed by 90% for 0.5 seconds.

20.name: Demonic Circle
20.description: Summon a Demonic Circle at Gul'dan's location. Activate to teleport Gul'dan to the Demonic Circle.

20.name: Ruinous Affliction
20.description: Corruption deals an additional 78 damage on impact. If the enemy is hit by all three strikes, the third strike deals 268 damage.{highlight}Each time an enemy hero is hit, they are marked by Gul'dan's envy, stealing all healing received by 40% for 6 seconds. Receiving extra stacks resets the duration.{/highlight}
20.developerCommentary: I like this talent but with how i wanted to rework it there wasn't much space for it BUT i also wanted something that would make Gul'dan steal healing so WE GOT AN OPPORTUNITY
subtexts: Receiving extra stacks resets the duration
This is not reduced healing effect is literally healing stealing

developerCommentary: I like Gul'dan's gameplay and how he has developed in various aspects, but just because I like something doesn't mean it's solid. Currently, he faces two serious problems: one where one of his ultimates is basically losing a talent by picking it, and the other is that his talents have been molded into a funnel shape. What I mean is that there is little room for variability in Gul'dan's talents, especially if you choose to go for the <vanilla, abilities, basic, 1> build. What I initially thought could be something simple, I realized how difficult it is to change his talents without altering his entire structure and completely changing how Gul'dan should choose his talents, since the talents themselves are not necessarily bad or uncreative and with that i will probally kill some builds and i will instead make it a more all-rounded mage to preserve something i really like on Heroes of the Storm talent tree system and that's the possibility of mixing builds.
